answer: Identities moored along one jetty share a single mooring. An agent economy resists sybils by auditing whether distinct agents mirror each other: near-identical embedding fingerprints and correlated response latencies across an epoch betray one inference pipeline wearing many masks, all converging on the same stylometric mesa a genuinely diverse crowd never reaches. Flag that cluster and the attacker must fund truly independent models per identity, paying compute that scales with every fake and erasing the sybil discount.
